digest_markdown:
• [1] A software supply chain attack compromised SolarWinds' Orion IT monitoring system, allowing hackers to deliver backdoor malware in a software update, affecting approximately 18,000 customers. [1]
• [1] A GHAPPIER supply chain attack compromised 65 GitHub repositories, infecting 73 files across 22 accounts, using a legitimate npm package to distribute a malicious loader to users. [2]
• [1] An undercover Google analyst infiltrated a notorious supply-chain hacking gang called TeamPCP, allowing Google to monitor the hacking spree from the inside and warn breach targets. [3]
• [1] A GlassWorm-linked supply chain campaign abused Visual Studio Code color themes to distribute malicious loaders, hiding malware inside seemingly harmless extensions. [4]
• [1] The GlassWorm campaign used a staged malware loader tied to the campaign, containing a Solana address and an AES key, which allowed operators to rotate command-and-control destinations without publishing a new extension version. [4]
